title: Runtime provider options drop configured sibling routing fields (allow_fallbacks, sort, etc.) on image requests
body:
In `doGenerate`, the request body spreads runtime provider options over the configured provider object:
https://github.com/OpenRouterTeam/ai-sdk-provider/blob/b96b20799eadeb72a180ef021b85254fc1500746/src/image/index.ts#L106-L111

Because object spread replaces `provider` wholesale rather than merging it, any per-call `providerOptions.openrouter.provider` erases every sibling field set in the model's configured `provider` (`allow_fallbacks`, `require_parameters`, `sort`, `only`, `ignore`, `data_collection`, `max_price`).

**Reproduction**
1. Create the image model with `provider: { order: ['google'], allow_fallbacks: true }`.
2. Call it with `providerOptions.openrouter.provider = { order: ['black-forest-labs'] }`.
3. Inspect the `POST /images` body: `provider` is `{ order: ['black-forest-labs'] }`; `allow_fallbacks` is gone.

**Effect**
The upstream routing request silently loses fallback/routing constraints, so a request can go to an unintended provider or fail when the chosen one is down.

**Suggested fix**
Build `provider` separately and shallow-merge the configured and runtime provider objects instead of letting the outer spread overwrite it.

_Found while testing [Ito](https://ito.ai), an automated code-review tool, against recently-merged PRs. It's free for open source. Sharing this because it looked like a real bug worth fixing, not to sell anything: https://app.ito.ai/share/43ff51ec-5766-43d5-bee3-9cbf6f1ef366?tab=details_
